editorial.name: Stripe Startups
editorial.descriptionZh: Stripe Startups 是 Stripe 面向获风投支持的初创公司的项目页（荷兰站 en-nl），符合条件可申请折扣、活动与内容。页面先把 Payments、Revenue、Money management、Platforms and marketplaces 四条产品线摊开，再落到 Start. Scale. Grow. 的申请入口。
editorial.takeawayZh: 学它用满屏飘带托住一叠真实账单卡片
editorial.noteZh: 首屏左边是 Start. Scale. Grow. 三个词一行，右边一大块品红到粉的飘带，上面浮着 Instant payout €280.81 / Pending balance €341.42、September summary、Revenue recognition €5,839,417.15 几张真实面板，右下角还弹出一条 You are viewing our website for the Netherlands, but it looks like you are in the United States。标题下三行写 Incorporate your company, test and accept payments with no-code tools, and automate financial operations to move faster.，再往下是一张白卡，卡头是 STRIPE STARTUPS 与 Apply for the programme，正文说 Designed to support venture-backed businesses that are just getting started.。顶栏是全站统一的 Products、Solutions、Developers、Resources 四组下拉，Pricing 与 Sign in 在右，花瓣状的 Payments 展开里能看到 Managed Payments、Authorization Boost、Financial Connections 这些条目。
editorial.pricing: unknown——本页没有价目，只有 Apply for the programme 与全站 Pricing 入口

reasons.statement: 这是一页项目申请落地页，交付的是 Stripe Startups 的资格说明与 Apply for the programme 按钮，没有可下载的组件或模板；候选池从 saaslandingpage.com 落地页灵感目录收录，故归产品与公司官网。
站点地图里全是 /en-nl/payments、/en-nl/billing、/en-nl/issuing 这类自家产品页，加上本页的申请入口，是产品的对外门面而不是资源库。
